observations.content: order-service is a Node.js microservice deployed on Kubernetes namespace prod-commerce
order-service depends on inventory-service via gRPC on port 50051
order-service uses @company/shared-proto v2.4.0 for gRPC type definitions
Last successful deploy was 2026-03-20, commit abc123
inventory-service runs Go on Kubernetes namespace prod-commerce
inventory-service upgraded to @company/shared-proto v3.0.0 on 2026-03-22 with breaking field renames
inventory-service health check endpoint is /healthz on port 8080
@company/shared-proto v3.0.0 renamed item_count to quantity and sku_id to product_sku across all proto definitions
v3.0.0 migration guide is in docs/migration-v3.md in the shared-proto repo
Deployments go through CI (lint, test, build) then staging rollout then prod rollout via ArgoCD
Staging environment shares the same inventory-service instance as prod for cost reasons
prod-commerce namespace has resource quotas: 4 CPU, 8Gi memory per pod
Pod restart policy is Always with a backoff limit of 5
